  QualifiedPackage upstream.literals
  public struct Tagged<T>
    field enabled: Boolean
    field label: String
    field value: T
  public fun inspect<T>(value: Tagged<T>, read: (T) -> Int): Int
    =
      WhenExpression
        Var value
        arm Tagged(true, "hit", item)
          Call read
            Var item
        arm Tagged(false, _, _)
          IntLiteral 0
        else
          Unary Neg
            IntLiteral 1
  public fun defaulted<T>(value: T, read: (T) -> Int, score: Int = <expr>): Int
    =
      Var score
